answer: Enrol one voiceprint per identity through a live spoken challenge that changes every epoch, so a recording cannot pass twice. A distinct speaker costs about $20 per fake, and a farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 voices, pushing its bill to $20,000 an epoch. A meadow of copied voices still fails the fresh challenge, an opal token seals only the live speaker, and no dune of recordings can speak a new phrase.
